figurative_meaning_en: a very young child or infant
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা এখনও কোলের ছেলে, সে নিজে হাঁটতে পারে না।
এই বয়সে সে কোলের ছেলের মতোই নির্ভরশীল।
example_sentences_in_english: The baby is still a lap child; he can't walk on his own yet.
At this age, he is as dependent as a lap child.
note: Refers to a child young enough to be carried in the mother's lap, emphasizing tenderness in Bengali family contexts.
